announcements.headline: Wereldhave Trading update Q3 2026
announcements.insight: This announcement provides a scheduled interim trading update for the third quarter of 2026. The headline does not indicate the direction or magnitude of performance, so it represents routine information release rather than a material event.

announcements.headline: Wereldhave sells Eggert Center in Purmerend to Transitions Europe, a French real estate investment fund, and retains asset management mandate
announcements.insight: Wereldhave disposes of Eggert Center to Transitions Europe while retaining the asset management mandate. This follows the earlier appointment of Remco Langewouters as Statutory Manager.

announcements.headline: Wereldhave announces the proposed appointment of Mr. Remco Langewouters as Statutory Managing Director and Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and convenes EGM
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies a change in senior executive leadership, specifically the appointment of a new Statutory Managing Director and CFO, which is a standard governance event. Such board changes are typically monitored by shareholders for continuity but do not inherently indicate immediate strategic shifts or financial performance implications.
